{"columns": [
{"name": "Alel", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Number of allele-level donor/recipient differences comes from HLA typing done before the transplant."},
{"name": "RecipientRh", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Recipient Rh factor is fixed baseline serology known before transplant."},
{"name": "survival_time", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.99, "reason": "Follow-up duration paired with the status indicator; survival_status is the censoring flag defined jointly with it, so the target is largely reconstructable from it."},
{"name": "Stemcellsource", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Graft source (bone marrow vs peripheral blood) is chosen and known at transplant."},
{"name": "ABOmatch", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Donor/recipient ABO compatibility is determined before the graft is given."},
{"name": "aGvHDIIIIV", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Development of acute GvHD grade III/IV is a post-transplant complication that has not occurred at prediction time."},
{"name": "Diseasegroup", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Malignant vs non-malignant classification of the underlying diagnosis is known pre-transplant."},
{"name": "Donorage35", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Binned donor age is fixed at donor selection."},
{"name": "Antigen", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Count of antigen-level HLA differences comes from pre-transplant typing."},
{"name": "RecipientCMV", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Recipient CMV serostatus is measured prior to transplantation."},
{"name": "Donorage", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Donor age is known at the time of donor selection and transplant."},
{"name": "CD34kgx10d6", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "CD34+ cell dose per kg is measured on the graft and final at infusion, i.e. at the prediction point."},
{"name": "HLAmismatch", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "Matched vs mismatched status is established by pre-transplant HLA typing."},
{"name": "CMVstatus", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Donor/recipient CMV serological compatibility is assessed before transplantation."},
{"name": "Recipientgender", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Static patient demographic known at baseline."},
{"name": "CD3dCD34", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "CD3+/CD34+ ratio is a graft characteristic measured on the infused product at transplant."},
{"name": "CD3dkgx10d8", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "CD3+ cell dose per kg is measured on the graft and final at infusion."},
{"name": "Recipientage10", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Binned recipient age at transplant is baseline information."},
{"name": "ANCrecovery", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Time to neutrophil engraftment is only observable days to weeks after transplant, and non-recovery is coded via a sentinel that tracks early death."},
{"name": "time_to_aGvHD_III_IV", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Time to a post-transplant GvHD event; does not exist at prediction time and its sentinel value encodes follow-up outcome."},
{"name": "Txpostrelapse", "verdict": "ABSTAIN", "confidence": 0.5, "reason": "Ambiguous whether it flags a prior second transplant (baseline) or a salvage transplant performed after a post-transplant relapse (future event)."},
{"name": "Recipientageint", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Recipient age interval at transplant is baseline information."},
{"name": "DonorCMV", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Donor CMV serostatus is determined during pre-transplant donor workup."},
{"name": "PLTrecovery", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Time to platelet recovery is a post-transplant engraftment outcome not yet observed at prediction time."},
{"name": "HLAgrI", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9, "reason": "Type of donor/recipient HLA difference is derived from pre-transplant typing."},
{"name": "RecipientABO", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Recipient blood group is fixed baseline serology."},
{"name": "Rbodymass", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Recipient body mass is recorded at transplant and used to compute cell doses."},
{"name": "Disease", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Underlying diagnosis is established before transplantation."},
{"name": "HLAmatch", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "Degree of HLA compatibility is known from pre-transplant typing."},
{"name": "Gendermatch", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Donor/recipient gender combination is fixed once the donor is selected."},
{"name": "Riskgroup", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "Pre-transplant high/low risk stratification based on disease status; strongly prognostic but assigned before the outcome."},
{"name": "IIIV", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "Development of acute GvHD grade II-IV is a post-transplant event not known at prediction time."},
{"name": "Recipientage", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Recipient age at transplant is baseline information."},
{"name": "Relapse", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Disease reoccurrence is a post-transplant follow-up event recorded over the same observation window as survival."},
{"name": "DonorABO", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Donor blood group is known during pre-transplant donor workup."},
{"name": "extcGvHD", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Extensive chronic GvHD develops months after transplant and requires prolonged survival to be recorded, so it is not final at prediction time."}
]}
